errors.text_span: The chart is divided into 12 slices
errors.evidence: The pie chart is divided into 10 slices (English, Spanish, Russian, German, French, Chinese, Thai, Portuguese, Catalan, and Other), not 12.
The slice for "Other" is colored white or very light pale blue, not medium blue.

errors.text_span: they decrease in size from top to bottom
errors.evidence: This description of the slice arrangement is incorrect. The slices on the right side of the chart generally increase in size from top to bottom (from Catalan at 1.6% to Russian at 5.7%).
The value for the English slice is exactly 42.8% as labeled in the chart. The word 'approximately' is unnecessary and makes the description less precise.
